content.comment_body: First, apologies if a similar topic has already been discussed, but I couldn't find time to search all forum threads. I'm facing an issue connecting [product_name] to a PC. In the software, I keep receiving a 'Transmission error (Timeout. [product_name] does not respond)' whenever I attempt communication between the devices. I've reviewed the installation instructions, which only describe USB cable usage. I'm uncertain if I've missed anything and have run out of troubleshooting ideas. Thanks in advance.

Hi [user_name], Check the COM port setting as follows: From the [product_name] software, go to TOOLS, then OPTIONS, then INTERFACE. With a powered [product_name] connected to a COM port on your PC, use Automatic Detection. Observe the changing text as each port is tested. If a [product_name] is found, that port will be used for downloads. You can verify this by updating the clock on the [product_name]: TOOLS → TRANSFER → SET CLOCK → CURRENT TIME → WRITE Check the information box to confirm if the time has been set successfully. If communication still fails, go to your Windows control panel, then system, hardware, device manager, and review the available port numbers. Sometimes modem or Bluetooth virtual COM drivers reserve port numbers. The [product_name] software prefers lower COM port numbers, typically not above 5. Hope this helps!
Hello [user_name], I wish I had found your advice three days ago. Unfortunately, I couldn't fix the connection problem, so I returned the controller. Thank you for your help! Greetings from Bosnia.
Hi [user_name], I'm not always active on the forum since I have other work commitments. I hope you received a replacement [product_name] and things are working better now!
Thank you, [user_name]. Wishing you all the best and a great day!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered ongoing connection errors while trying to link their PC and [product_name] using a COM port cable, receiving repeated timeout alerts that interfered with their workflow. Key usability concerns included setup difficulties, vague documentation particularly for non-USB connections, and the slow support response, all of which prevented quick troubleshooting. As a result, the user returned the device before resolving the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected an uncomplicated and dependable communication setup between PC and [product_name] using a standard COM port cable, along with comprehensive instructions for this process. Immediate troubleshooting guidance and prompt support response were also anticipated to quickly resolve connection issues.
